'''Raimun Holdwin''' is the innkeeper of the [[Goose and Crown]], in [[Andor]].

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] are making their way to [[Caemlyn]], they stop in the last village within sight of the Goose and Crown. Passing through, they are waiting for a safe moment to move on when they see Master Holdwin talking with a [[Myrddraal]].{{ref/book|1|34}} Master Holdwin then talks with [[Almen Bunt]] about two people, one with a [[blademaster]]'s sword. Master Bunt doesn't know anything about it and later gives a ride to Rand and Mat. Master Bunt doesn't like Raimun Holdwin, due to his "friends."{{ref/book|1|35}}
